reason: A read-only DSH plugin audits injected instructions, skill catalogs, tool schemas, and MCP tools, presenting token estimates, duplication or shadowing conflicts, and optimization suggestions through a model tool and web panel.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的 DSH 上下文审计插件，用于统计指令、技能和工具 schema 的 token 成本并发现重复或冲突。
summaries.en: A read-only DSH context-auditing plugin that estimates token costs across instructions, skills, and tool schemas and identifies duplication or shadowing conflicts.

capabilities: read-only filesystem inspection of instruction files, skill catalogs, and tool schemas
token-cost estimation and duplicate or conflict detection
exposes an HTTP audit endpoint and a context_audit model tool
renders audit summaries in a web UI
